name: Renjou Kata no Melancholy
original_name: 恋情過多のメランコリー
source:
A Renjou Kata no Euphoria survey thank work.
It's an ultra-short game about the events that took place after Nid's bad end route.

[Translated from [url=http://sunset77light.rdy.jp/game_my.html]Official site[/url].]
translation:
《Renjou Kata no Euphoria》调查感谢工作。
这是一款关于Nid糟糕的结局路线之后发生的事件的超短游戏。

[译自[url=http://sunset77light.rdy.jp/game_my.html]官方网站[/url].]
